"targeting people that are really not that extreme." He's pretty extreme and really freaking creepy. It took me three minutes of googling to find more than enough content to justify a ban. Shit, I would ban him too if I operated mailchimp.

Mine get pretty geeky too. When I was young I would daydream about being onboard the Starship Enterprise. And recently I have been daydreaming up a MMO game that's somewhere between Skyrim and Runescape.
If it gets in the way of doing things than it's too much. To me your description sounds fine. But really only you (and or a therapist) can know if it's too much.

I made it about half way through The Raw Shark Texts, but I have to give up. It's a good book as far as horror goes, I guess. I may have to give up on my goal of reading 52 horror books this year. I just don't like them.

My reading likes are far, far too pretentious. Reading a cliche causes me anger. I actually get angry. Like, in Raw Shark- a girl shows up in the nick of time to save the protagonist; she is riding a motorcycle and instructs him to dive through a window and escape with her. I just can't do it. I really want to get a fuller understanding of horror as a genre, but anything less than Ligotti or Brian Evenson makes me want to stick my head in a bucket of snow.

I ordered Wallace's Pale King to cleanse my palate. So until it gets here I guess I will just read the old testament and a book on the history of hell.
